title: One more stool
req: “The bar counter Brush70 could use one more stool at its west end. Extend the counter westward and add a matching stool to continue the row.”

entries.what: bar counter's west face; must extend 112 units west to make room, without disturbing its top or east end

before.note: The counter (Brush70) runs X[-896,-384], already carrying 5 evenly-spaced stools (112 units apart) with no gap -- the row is full; extending the counter is the only way to add a sixth.
